root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward joining and softness, developing toward things gathered densely, abundantly, or compactly, and toward household goods collected for use.
root_idea.development: The lexical development runs from abundance and dense growth to abundant household property and furnishings; related uses also describe something made smooth or easy to lie, ride, or walk upon.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun أثاث is a distinct lexical item meaning household goods and, by extension, abundant property or possessions.

senses.definition: Household goods, furnishings, utensils, and other equipment kept for domestic use.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective noun for the goods and conveniences of a household, especially when considered as an accumulated household furnishing.

senses.definition: Property or possessions considered collectively, especially abundant property.
senses.usage_conditions: The term can extend beyond household furnishings to property or possessions as a whole when they are plentiful.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become abundant, numerous, or great; of herbage, to become plentiful and luxuriant or tall; of hair, to become abundant and long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb describing increase in quantity, density, or extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become large in the hinder parts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specifically anatomical use said of a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something plain, level, smooth, soft, or easy to lie, ride, or walk upon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II transitive construction applied to a surface or place made comfortable or traversable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To obtain or acquire goods, household furnishings, property, wealth, or other comforts of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V reflexive or intransitive construction describing acquisition of material goods or prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goods intended for use, rather than merchandise; in a reported usage, new household utensils or furnishings rather than old and worn items.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are Classical usage distinctions attached to the noun and are not required for its Quranic occurrences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundant, dense, luxuriant, tall, or long; of herbage or hair, thick and luxuriant, and of a beard, thick; of a woman, fleshy or full-grown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective whose precise nuance varies with the described subject; the examples do not impose a general object-class restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stone of the three-stone cooking tripod on which a cooking-pot is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun, also used for the set of tripod stones; the form involves a reported consonant substitution in relation to أَثَافِيّ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit's abundance and dense-growth verb meanings are represented.
The anatomical construction is represented separately.
The causative smoothing and leveling meaning is represented.
Pointer-only unit referring to أَثِيث; it adds no independent lexical meaning.
The unit supports household goods, abundant property, and additional Classical use distinctions.
The adjective's abundance, density, luxuriance, and subject-specific nuances are represented.
The specialized cooking-tripod meaning is represented.

cautions: أَثَاث is treated in the lexical evidence as a collective noun; authorities differ on whether it has a singular form أَثَاثَة or no singular of its own.
